ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with a dominant low-intensity background (dark grey/black) and approximately 15% high-intensity pixels localized in white scars and calcified clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark base layer. High-intensity annular clusters mapped to [x=25-45%, y=40-75%] and [x=65-85%, y=40-75%]. High-intensity contiguous white masses mapped exclusively to the distal tips of both fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 18% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. Amplitude of peaks varies between 5 and 25 pixels, with deepest indentations located on the medial sections of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward sweep originating from the median notch, transitioning to a slight convexity at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial clusters of circular and ring-shaped high-contrast marks (scars) on the lower-middle regions of both lobes. Dense, high-relief white pixel clusters (calcified barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of three parallel vertical linear marks (rake marks) on the upper left lobe; multiple unaligned, curved white linear disruptions on the lower right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (rosettes) across the ventral surface; heavy colonization of barnacles on the trailing edge tips resulting in modified edge geometry.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific fringe-like appearance of calcified barnacle clusters at the tips provides a highly unique textural signature.
